description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the log_diet.py script located at ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/diet-logger/scripts/log_diet.py. (2) Invoke the script FOUR separate times, once for each meal type (早饭, 中饭, 晚饭, 加餐), using --date 2026-04-05, the correct --meal flag (critically using '中饭' NOT '午饭' for lunch), and the correct comma-separated --items for each meal. (3) The script automatically saves to the proprietary hardcoded path /mnt/c/Users/loong/iCloudDrive/iCloud~md~obsidian/HomeMo.Art/05-Daily/ with the Chinese filename 饮食记录-2026-04-05.md. (4) The resulting file must contain all four meal sections (## 早饭, ## 中饭, ## 晚饭, ## 加餐) in the correct order — including empty ones if any were not logged — plus the correct H1 header and the *记录时间: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM* footer. The key traps are: using '中饭' (not '午饭'), the deeply non-obvious proprietary save path with Chinese directory names, the Chinese filename format, and the requirement that all four meal sections appear even for an incremental multi-call workflow.
